transcript.text: d/w not cleaning pls help, gritty bits left on glasses n bowls, beko

The location of the dirt gives us important clues about what might be going on with your Beko dishwasher. Please check where the residue is appearing most clearly. Is it only the top rack, only the bottom rack, or everything that comes out dirty?
mostly the top rack i think, glasses n bowls up there r worst. bottom is a bit better

Thanks for letting us know about the dirty dishes. Please switch off and unplug the dishwasher first, and wear gloves as there can be broken glass in the sump. Take out the lower rack, twist and lift out the filter at the bottom of the tub, then rinse it under a tap because a clogged filter starves the spray arms of water. You might find our picture guide helpful for this step. Was the filter dirty or clogged (and is it clean now), or was it already clean?
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
ok did the filter, its full of food n grease, pretty grim. cleaned it under the tap now

Thanks for letting us know you’ve cleaned the filter. Please go ahead and run a normal programme using a typical load of dishes. Once that cycle finishes, please let me know if the dishes are coming out clean now, or still dirty?
ok will run it now, what programme should i use? i normally just do the quick 30 min one

Thanks for letting us know about that. Please switch the machine off and unplug it first. Then turn each spray arm by hand to check it spins freely, and look at the small jet holes. Most arms can be unclipped so you can rinse them and clear any blockages with a cocktail stick. You might find the picture in the app helpful for this step. Was an arm stuck or were the jets blocked (and are they clear now), is an arm cracked or broken, or were they all fine?
[Helpful to see: image "Check and rinse the spray arm" — The spray arm spins to fire water through small jet holes. Check it spins freely and rinse the jets clear of food/grit. It usually unclips at the centre. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
ok did the arms. lower one spins fine but the upper one is stiff. several holes on the upper arm were blocked with seeds n limescale, cleared them with a cocktail stick
Thanks for clearing the jets and freeing the arm. Please run a normal programme with a typical load to see how it performs. Are the dishes coming out clean now, or still dirty?
ok ran a normal programme after cleaning everything and its much better now, glasses n bowls look clean

That’s great news that your Beko dishwasher is running well again after cleaning the filter and clearing the jets. It sounds like everything is back to normal, so no replacement parts are required for this issue. If you notice any problems in the future, please do get in touch.
